prior_assessment.source_basis: Before 6 November 2026 the catalogue and WikiTree attached Anne Glasgow as Mary Glasgow's mother only as an unassessed family-tree link ('parent' attachment with no status or percentage); none is invented.

relationships.basis: No record in the research set (the canonical records and the Ancestry transcripts under glasgow-records, searched on the child's name and year and on the mother's name beside the father's) names Anne Glasgow as the mother of Mary Glasgow. The attachment rests on the family tree alone. Circumstances: she is the one wife the tree gives the attached father; she would have been 16 at the birth, which fits. Assessed at 45% (possible), apart from the father link (45%).
